name: Csehimindszent (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and yellow at the fly, charged at the centre of the red with the municipal arms of Csehimindszent: a red shield with a yellow charge and a bishop's mitre, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
